title: Add Pages entry point and Create Page button next to Groups

requirements.text: Add a new primary navigation item labeled "Pages" next to the existing "Groups" item in the bottom navigation, and make it navigate to a new route at "/pages".

quotes: create page button beside of groups button where users can create pages

acceptanceCriteria: Bottom navigation shows a "Pages" item positioned adjacent to "Groups".
The active-state styling works for the new "/pages" route similarly to existing tabs (e.g., Home/Groups).

requirements.text: On the existing Groups page header, add a "Create Page" button placed beside the existing "Create Group" button; clicking it should navigate users to a new route at "/pages/create".

quotes: create page button beside of groups button where users can create pages

acceptanceCriteria: The Groups page header displays both "Create Group" and "Create Page" actions side-by-side on desktop widths and remains usable on mobile widths (no overlap/cutoff).

requirements.text: Create a new Pages listing screen at route "/pages" and a Create Page screen at route "/pages/create". The Create Page screen must include a form with the following fields and basic client-side validation: Page Name (required), Category (Politics / News / Business / Community / Public Figure), Description, Profile Image upload, Cover Image upload, Visibility (Public / Private), and a Verification request toggle. Submitting the form should show an English user-facing message indicating the creation flow is not yet persisted (until backend support is implemented).

quotes: create page button beside of groups button where users can create pages

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to "/pages" renders a Pages screen (it may show an empty/placeholder state, but must not crash).
Navigating to "/pages/create" renders the Create Page form with all specified fields.
Form validation prevents submission when Page Name is empty and displays an English validation message.
Submitting a valid form shows an English toast/notification that the create flow is not yet persisted, and the app remains stable.

requirements.text: Add a new static icon asset for the bottom navigation "Pages" item and use it in the same way the existing Groups icon is used (image-based icon).

quotes: create page button beside of groups button where users can create pages

acceptanceCriteria: A new icon file exists under frontend/public/assets/generated and is referenced by the bottom navigation for the "Pages" tab.
The icon renders correctly in the bottom navigation and follows the same active/inactive behavior as the Groups icon.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths (use safe alternatives).
Backend changes are out of scope for this request; the Create Page form should not require new backend APIs to function.
nonGoals: Implementing full Pages backend storage, querying, followers, roles/permissions, posting, moderation, or analytics.
Linking Pages to Groups or changing existing Groups backend behavior.
